newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-CHESTERFIELD STUN FOREST IN CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CHESTERFIELD STUN FOREST IN CUP.

text.p: Second division Chesterfield pulled off a classic English FA Cup upset on Saturday by beating premier league Nottingham Forest 1-0 to reach the quarter-finals for the first time in more than 100 years of trying.
On a day of surprises, second division Wrexham came from behind to win 3-1 at first division Birmingham and premier league aristocrats Leeds were beaten 3-2 at home by Portsmouth.

Middlesbrough and Wimbledon became the only top flight teams definitely through to the last eight with victories over first division sides Manchester City (1-0 away) and Queens Park Rangers (2-1) respectively.
In the one outstanding fourth-round match Coventry recovered from leaking a goal after 50 seconds to win 2-1 at Blackburn.
Two more fifth-round ties take place on Sunday when Cup favourites Chelsea visit Leicester and second division Bradford entertain Sheffield Wednesday.

In league action Arsenal missed the chance to go top of the premier league standings when they were held to a goalless draw at north London rival Tottenham and Derby beat relegation rival West Ham 1-0.
